title: Sunscreen SPF50

drivers.name: Back-to-school season
drivers.evidence: Noise-adjusted effect from 7 past weeks is x1.0; 2026-08-03 lift was due to promotion, not season alone.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 74.4. No price change (current price = regular). The 'Back-to-school season' event has a noise-adjusted effect of x1.0, per 7 past occurrences, including a strong lift in 2026-08-03 (x1.68) due to a 10% promo. That promotion was also in a back-to-school week, but its lift is already captured in the baseline trend. The classical model suggests no uplift, but the 2026-08-03 week shows a real lift, though not replicable in other back-to-school weeks. The past promotion effect is noise-adjusted to x1.01. No evidence of post-promo dip. No new drivers. The baseline already reflects recent seasonal ramps.
